polishes.name: Sure Shot
polishes.description: The colour originally named Sundown is now named Sunset Over The Bay It was recently brought to my attention that the word “Sundown” can carry harmful historical associations. In the past, “Sundown towns” referred to communities in the United States that enforced racial segregation by excluding non-white individuals through discriminatory laws, intimidation, and even violence. While this was more common prior to the 1950s, some of these towns still exist today and the history connected to the term is understandably upsetting. Although these practices were made illegal under the Civil Rights Act of 1968, it’s widely acknowledged that prejudice and exclusion haven’t disappeared entirely. In many places, people still experience discrimination on a daily basis, which is why awareness and inclusivity remain so important. The word “Sundown” isn’t something many people immediately recognise as having negative associations ( which is why I didn’t really think twice about using it  ). But in reality it can still be hurtful for some, and I want to be mindful of that. I truly appreciate this being bought to my attention by a fellow polish lover who took the time to educate me. My intention is always to create products that feel positive and welcoming to everyone, and never to cause harm or discomfort. polishes.name: What We Deserve
polishes.description: A clear glitter topper polish filled with assorted silver holographic glitters. This glitter polish is designed to be worn over other colours, top coat recommended for a glossy finish. Hate removing glitter nail polish? Try our Peel Off Base Coat! Larger glitters can be difficult to use if you are not used to them. These are my top tips 1 - Shake well 2 - Turn the bottle upside down ( closed of course ) for a few minutes before using. This helps to bring the glitters up to the surface. 3 - Immediately after, dip the brush in and VERY quickly take it out. If you take your time taking the brush back out of the bottle, the larger glitters will just slide back off the brush. You can use the neck of the bottle to help get them out too. 4 - Dab, don't swipe. Instead of applying like a normal polish, you want to dab or pat the polish on. This helps place the glitters where you want them rather than dragging them off the nail. Use a thick coat so you can move them around easily. 5 - Use 2 coats of top coat for a smooth glossy finish. ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ Product images courtesy of: @doseoflolade @lacquer_is_life @thepolishedmage @_always_polished_ @a_painted_queen @polishedbookworm @cosmeticsanctuary @failnartiste @chloes_nails088 @PolishedSteph @thepolishblog ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ Hashtag #emilydemollywhatthefutureholds and tag @emilydemolly for a chance to be featured!
